note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). disable-model-invocation: true means this is a command-species skill — routing cases still document intent, but the model never auto-invokes it.

cases.prompt: Wire this working session to the repo's live marshal so I can forward fleet-shaped asks.
Connect me to the marshal that's already running for this repo.
Introduce this session to {repo}-marshal and get its status ack plus the roster.
I need to forward a mobilize decision to the fleet marshal from this terminal — hook me up first.
Cold-start the whole fleet from this one terminal.
cases.comment: owner: teamwork:fleet-bootstrap — stands up/BECOMES the marshal, doesn't connect to an already-live one

cases.prompt: Bootstrap this session as the fleet's agent seat.
cases.comment: owner: teamwork:team-scaffolding — binds THIS session AS a seat, not connecting to an existing one

cases.prompt: Should a fleet-shaped ask route to the marshal or be handled here — what's the standing triage rule?
cases.comment: owner: teamwork:fleet-rules Section 7 — the routing doctrine itself, not the one-time handshake that wires a session up to use it

cases.prompt: Retire the reviewer seat, this session held it.
cases.comment: owner: teamwork:team-scaffolding retire — releasing a seat, not connecting to the marshal
